description: React component for displaying and selecting recently used custom dates in a rich text editor's send button options, utilizing Luxon for date handling and Redux for state management.

classes.name: RecentUsedCustomDate
classes.description: Interface representing a recently used custom date with optional update and timestamp fields.

methods.name: isTimestampWithinLast30Days
methods.description: Checks if a given timestamp is within the last 30 days relative to a specified timezone.

methods.name: shouldShowRecentlyUsedCustomTime
methods.description: Determines whether the recently used custom time should be displayed based on various conditions.

methods.name: getDateOption
methods.description: Returns date formatting options based on whether the date is in the current week.
